title: Claims Settlement Guidance: Estimate Settlement Share on Cleaning and Damage Fees Damage Charges
content:
**Rule.** The estimate settlement share of a Cleaning and Damage Fees damage fee approved at review is read from the repair documents on the evidence ledger: when no final repair receipt is on file and exactly one repair estimate submission is on file, it is the single-estimate share; when no final repair receipt is on file and two or more repair estimate submissions are on file (a shop estimate checked against a second estimate), it is the corroborated-estimate share; when a final repair receipt is on file the whole repair amount on file is settled.

The amount the damage fee charged on approval is based on is the repair amount on file multiplied by the estimate settlement share.

| Repair documents on the assessment's evidence ledger | Settlement share of the repair amount on file |
|---|---|
| no repair receipt submission, exactly one repair estimate submission | 85% (single estimate) |
| no repair receipt submission, two or more repair estimate submissions | 95% (corroborated estimate) |
| at least one repair receipt submission | the whole amount |

The documents are counted from the repair estimate and repair receipt submissions on the evidence ledger of the assessment being approved.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- One shop estimate on the ledger and a repair amount on file of $600.00: $600.00 multiplied by 85%, that is $510.00.
- A shop estimate and a second estimate on the ledger, with a repair amount on file of $428.02: $428.02 multiplied by 95%, that is $406.619 before the fee's final rounding.
- A final repair receipt of $388.00 on the ledger: the whole $388.00 is settled, whatever estimates are also on file.
